title: Set 283

sentences.ko: 1월에 도자기 수업에 등록했는데, 솔직히 처음 한 달 정도는 정말 좋았어. 그런데 수업이 목요일 저녁으로 바뀌고 내가 계속 야근을 해야 해서 몇 번 빠졌거든. 그 뒤로는 다시 나가기가 좀 어색하더라.
sentences.text: I signed up for a pottery class back in January, and I honestly loved it for like the first month. But then they moved it to Thursday nights, and I kept having to work late, so I missed a few, and after that it just felt weird going back.

alts.text: So I started a pottery class in January and kinda loved it the first month. Then they switched it to Thursday nights, I kept getting stuck at work, missed a few, and after that going back just felt weird.

I enrolled in a pottery class in January, and I genuinely enjoyed it for approximately the first month. However, it was then moved to Thursday evenings, and I frequently had to work late, so I missed several sessions, and after that it felt awkward to return.

sentences.note: **signed up for** 는 수업이나 활동에 등록하다, 신청하다라는 뜻입니다. **felt weird going back** 은 다시 가기가 어색했다는 말로, 한동안 빠진 뒤의 머쓱한 기분을 나타냅니다.

sentences.ko: 정말 도와주고 싶은데, 너네 개를 일주일 내내 봐 주는 건 안 될 것 같아. 요즘 내가 집에 거의 없어서, 내가 일하는 동안 개한테 무슨 일이라도 생기면 평생 나 자신을 용서 못 할 거야.
sentences.text: I'd really love to help, but I don't think I should watch your dog for a whole week. I'm barely home right now, and if something happened to him while I was at work, I'd never forgive myself.

alts.text: Wish I could, but a whole week with your dog? I just don't think I can do it. I'm hardly ever home right now, and if something happened to him while I was at work, I'd never forgive myself.

I would very much like to help, but I do not believe I should look after your dog for an entire week. I am rarely at home at the moment, and if anything were to happen to him while I was at work, I would never forgive myself.

sentences.note: **watch your dog** 에서 watch 는 보다가 아니라 맡아서 돌봐 주다라는 뜻입니다. **I'd never forgive myself** 는 그런 일이 생기면 평생 자책할 거라는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 앉을 데를 찾으려고 카페를 한 세 군데쯤 돌았는데, 하나같이 노트북 하는 사람들로 꽉 차 있었어. 그래서 포기하고 내 차에서 커피를 마셨는데, 솔직히 그렇게 나쁘지 않았어.
sentences.text: We went to like three different coffee shops looking for somewhere to sit, and every single one was full of people on laptops. So we gave up and drank our coffee in my car, which honestly wasn't that bad.

alts.text: We tried like three coffee shops to find a seat, and every one was packed with laptop people. So we gave up and had our coffee in my car, and honestly? Not that bad.

We visited approximately three different coffee shops in search of a place to sit, and every one of them was full of people working on laptops. We therefore gave up and drank our coffee in my car, which was, in all honesty, not unpleasant.

sentences.note: **every single one** 은 하나도 빠짐없이 전부라는 뜻으로, every one 보다 더 힘을 줍니다. **wasn't that bad** 는 생각보다 괜찮았다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 회사 가까이로 이사할까 계속 고민 중이야. 출퇴근 때문에 죽겠거든, 편도로 한 시간 반쯤 걸려. 그런데 지금 사는 동네가 정말 좋고 떠나면 그리울 걸 아니까, 마음이 계속 왔다 갔다 해.
sentences.text: I keep thinking about moving closer to work, because the commute is killing me, it's like an hour and a half each way. But I really love my neighborhood, and I know I'd miss it, so I just keep going back and forth.

alts.text: Moving closer to work keeps crossing my mind, 'cause the commute's killing me, like an hour and a half each way. But I love my neighborhood and I'd miss it, so I keep going back and forth.

I have been considering moving closer to my workplace, because the commute is exhausting; it takes approximately an hour and a half each way. However, I am very fond of my neighborhood and know I would miss it, so I remain undecided.

sentences.note: **the commute is killing me** 는 출퇴근이 너무 힘들어 죽겠다는 말입니다. **going back and forth** 는 결정을 못 하고 마음이 이랬다저랬다 한다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 내 폰이 자꾸 저절로 재부팅돼, 문자 쓰는 도중에 갑자기 말이야. 업데이트도 이미 했고 앱도 잔뜩 지웠는데 아직도 그래서, 아무래도 수리 맡겨야 할 것 같아.
sentences.text: My phone keeps restarting on its own, like right in the middle of a text. I already updated it and deleted a bunch of apps, but it's still doing it, so I think I'm going to have to take it in.

alts.text: Ugh, my phone keeps restarting by itself, like right in the middle of a text. Already updated it and deleted a bunch of apps, still doing it, so I'm gonna have to take it in.

My phone continues to restart on its own, sometimes in the middle of writing a message. I have already updated it and deleted a number of applications, but the problem persists, so I believe I will need to take it in for repair.

sentences.note: **on its own** 은 아무것도 안 했는데 저절로라는 뜻입니다. **take it in** 은 고치려고 가게나 서비스센터에 맡기다라는 말입니다.

reviewed: 1번 casual 의 So I did a pottery class starting in January 는 이어 붙인 티가 나서 So I started a pottery class in January 로 고쳤습니다.
2번 casual 의 I don't think so 는 거절로 들으면 퉁명스러워서, 부드럽게 거절하는 상황에 맞게 I just don't think I can do it 으로 바꿨습니다.
2번 note 에서 I'd never forgive myself 가 거절할 때 자주 쓰는 말이라고 한 것은 지나친 설명이라, 무슨 일이 생기면 자책할 거라는 뜻만 남겼습니다.
